verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs say recorded calls 'come back transcribed and summarized.' The API exposes a per-call summary endpoint (covering both regular and Sona-handled calls), and dedicated webhook families exist for call summaries and call transcripts, so both artifacts are tied to the call record. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that summaries and transcripts appear on the conversation in the app, a dedicated documented transcript-retrieval endpoint beyond webhooks and MCP access, and summaries being limited to Business and Scale plans.
